comment: Scripted flick for fixtures/scenes/scroll_static.json (openhost --script). The scroll view is subview 1 at root frame (20,30,200,280), contentOffset starts (30,155), max offset y = 630-280 = 350. Down at t=0.05, five -20pt moves every 20ms (1000 pt/s), lift at 0.16. MEASURED physics (M8, docs/APP_FEEL.md): pan recognizes on the first move (t=0.07) applying travel-10 = +10pt (offset 165); the remaining 80pt track 1:1 -> offset 245 at release with v = 1000 pt/s. Deceleration (0.998/ms, x = x0 + 0.499*v0*(1-0.998^ms), from the lift t=0.16) crosses the 350 edge at tc = ln(0.78957)/k = 0.118s carrying ~790 pt/s -> critically damped bounce (omega=11) peaks ~26.4pt past the edge at ~t=0.37, settles at exactly 350 by ~1.05, indicator fades 0.4s. Captures: initial, drag end (1:1), mid-momentum, bounce peak, spring return, settled + fading indicator, fully settled.
